move: cards pop from a point in grid order, overshoot, ripple, shrink out
how: Eight colour cards in a 4x2 CSS grid. They from() scale:0 rotate:-8 with back.out(1.7) over 0.9s, grid-staggered 0.09s from the top-left; names and hex rise with expo.out and a small blur swatch pops with back.out(2). At 0.4D a scale ripple runs from the centre outward: each card to scale 1.08 (power2.out, 0.3s) then back to 1 with elastic.out(1,0.5). At 0.83D the cards shrink back to scale 0 with rotate 6 and back.in(1.5), staggered from the far end, and the caption lifts away.
adapt: Change card colours/names/hex, caption text, and the grid dimensions (update the stagger grid:[rows,cols] to match). Keep back.out(1.7) entrance, the centre-out ripple and the back.in exit.
port: mount(el, shot) renders .cap and a .grid of .card elements from shot.colors; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entrance at 0.1/6*D, ripple at 2.4/6*D and exit at 5.0/6*D, using gsap.utils.toArray scoped to el.
caveats: backdrop-filter on .sw is a minor render cost
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when rebuilt
